# Training project (synthetic)

**These are not geological data.** Generated by `tools/make_tutorial.py` (seed 2026) for the training project of
CorAnTool (V19): seven fictitious cores at random sea positions of the Mediterranean (ENT-01 Alborán … ENT-07
Levantino), records driven by a simple climate of the last 40 ka (Holocene, Younger Dryas, Bølling-Allerød,
HS1-HS3, LGM), an organic layer (sapropel S1 6–10 ka in the east, ORL 8–14 ka in the west), random turbidites and
two tephra layers, and a synthetic core image of ENT-03 (0–150 cm, 25 px/cm) with drawn traces of four ichnotaxa
(`tutorial_truth.json` = position and true ichnotaxon of each drawn trace).

Files: `cores.csv` (long table), `catalogue.csv`, `age_models.csv`, `intervals_depth.csv` (turbidites, tephra),
`intervals_age.csv` (organic layer described only in ENT-01, -03, -04, -07; climatic periods), `tutorial_core.jpg`,
`tutorial_truth.json`.
